title: User admin — list users with roles/scopes, admin-only access
objective: Verify GET /admin/users returns users (display name, username, role, scopes, active flag) for system_admin only; non-admins get 403; secrets never present in payloads.
preconditions: Seeded users; admin + manager + operator sessions.
steps: GET list as admin; verify fields incl. role + scopes + active.
Scan payload for password/hash/token-like fields.
GET as manager and operator → expect 403.
expected_result: Admin-only visibility; complete non-secret user fields; zero credential material in any response; pagination envelope consistent.

title: Assign role and scopes — effective immediately and audited
objective: Verify PATCH /admin/users/:uuid changes role/scopes; the target user's effective permissions change on next request; the change is audited with before/after.
preconditions: Target user T (employee) with no scopes; admin session.
steps: As T: attempt POST /assets → expect 403 (pre-change control).
As admin: PATCH role/scopes for T.
As T: create asset in dept A → success; attempt asset in dept B → 404.
Verify audit event with before/after role/scope.
expected_result: Changes take effect without re-seeding; scope predicate enforced immediately; audit complete (actor=admin, before/after); invalid role/scope values → 400.

title: Deactivate user — sessions revoked/denied, records preserved
objective: Verify deactivating a user blocks their login/API access while preserving their historical records (assignments, audit authorship) intact.
preconditions: Active user U with an existing session and authored records.
test_data: PATCH {active: false} on U; then login + /auth/me attempts as U
steps: Deactivate U as admin.
Attempt login as U → expect failure (generic message).
Attempt API call with U's pre-existing session cookie → expect 401/403.
Verify U's historical assignment/audit records still reference U correctly.
expected_result: Access fully revoked (new login + existing session); history untouched; reactivation restores access; actions audited.

title: Cannot remove/deactivate the final active System Administrator
objective: Verify attempts to deactivate or demote the last active system_admin are rejected with a stable error; with 2+ admins, deactivating one succeeds.
preconditions: Exactly one active admin A1 in the test fixture (and a second admin A2 creatable).
test_data: PATCH {active:false} on A1; PATCH {role:'auditor'} on A1; then add A2 and retry deactivate A1
steps: Attempt deactivate A1 (sole admin) → record error.
Attempt demote A1 to auditor → record error.
Create/promote A2 to system_admin; deactivate A1 → success.
expected_result: Sole-admin operations rejected (409 or 400 with documented code, user-safe message); guard verified at service level (not only UI); successful path works once another admin exists; all attempts audited.

title: Audit-events read API — restricted, filterable, no mutation surface
objective: Verify GET /admin/audit-events is admin/auditor-only (per capability), filterable by actor/action/target/correlation/date, paginated, and exposes no edit/delete methods.
preconditions: Existing audit events from prior tests; admin, auditor, manager sessions.
test_data: filters: action=asset.create, correlation_id=<known>, date range; POST/PATCH/DELETE probes
steps: GET audit events as admin with each filter; verify matching subsets.
GET as auditor (per capability map) and manager → record allowed/denied.
Attempt unsafe methods on the endpoint and on a specific event.
expected_result: Read restricted per capability; filters + pagination envelope correct; 405/404 for mutations; sensitive payloads (none expected — no credentials anywhere in before/after JSONB, spot-check).

title: Archiving preserves references and history; no physical delete via operations
objective: Verify archiving an asset (record_status=archived) retains all assignments/lifecycle/audit/attachments references, removes it from default operational lists while remaining retrievable by authorized query, and no operational endpoint physically deletes business records.
preconditions: Asset with rich history (assignments, maintenance, attachments).
test_data: archive action (endpoint/config per delivery); default list; archived-inclusive query
steps: Archive the asset via the documented mechanism.
Verify default /assets list excludes it; archived-inclusive query finds it with full history.
Verify attachments still downloadable by authorized users; audit chain intact (recompute tail hash linkage if tooling exists).
Probe for any hard-delete surface (DELETE on business entities) → must not exist.
expected_result: Archive = logical only; history/references fully preserved and readable; no physical delete anywhere in the API surface; dashboards/reports treat archived per documented rules.

title: Retention rules and legal/audit hold prevent purge
objective: Verify configurable retention rules identify purge-eligible records, but records under legal/audit hold are never purged; purge execution (if delivered) is dry-run-first, audited, and admin-only.
preconditions: Retention config delivered; aged records; a record flagged on hold.
test_data: retention rule (e.g., archived > N years); hold flag on one record; purge dry-run/execute calls
steps: Evaluate retention → verify eligible set matches ground truth minus held records.
Verify held record excluded from any purge plan.
If purge execute exists: verify dry-run output, admin-only enforcement, and audit of actual purge; else verify documented 'retention evaluation only in v1'.
expected_result: Hold always wins; eligibility computed per configured rules; any destructive operation is gated, dry-runnable, and audited; no silent data loss.

title: Reference-data admin UI — manage values incl. deactivate semantics
objective: UI: admin manages reference data (create/edit/reorder/deactivate) at /admin/reference-data; in-use values show deactivate (not delete) with explanation; deactivated values hidden from pickers but retained on records.
test_data: a category and a location (one in-use)
steps: Create a new reference value via UI; verify it appears in asset form pickers.
Deactivate an in-use value; verify UI explains retention; verify existing records still display it and pickers exclude it.
Verify non-admin roles cannot reach the admin UI (403 page/redirect).
expected_result: UI mirrors BR-004 API semantics (verified C2); clear affordances and confirmations; role gating client+server. (Browser-unavailable → BLOCKED.)
